task.title: Evaluate required task Verification gates
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/773 with a deterministic read-only evaluation of caller-owned required checks for one exact task Attempt.
acceptance_criteria: Validate a non-empty unique gate set while preserving caller order.
Use the latest identified result for each required check linked to the exact Attempt and ignore unrelated or legacy evidence.
Report Failed before Pending before Passed while retaining every ordered per-check status.
Execute nothing, write no event, grant no permission, and leave task and workflow lifecycle unchanged.

attempts.summary: Established RED gate-set and evaluation coverage.
attempts.diagnostic: The focused gate tests failed because gate-set validation, per-check reports, aggregate status, typed evaluation errors, and the evaluator did not exist.
attempts.patch: Added empty/duplicate, authored-order, all-passed, failed-precedence, pending, latest-result, evidence-isolation, and invalid-Attempt tests.

attempts.diagnostic: Caller-owned check identities and append-ordered projected observations were sufficient to compute a deterministic report without persisting policy.
attempts.patch: Added validated gate sets, ordered per-check and aggregate reports, typed errors, exact-Attempt filtering, ADR, and lifecycle documentation.

attempts.summary: Preserved public error evolution after substantive review.
attempts.diagnostic: Review found that the two new public gate error enums omitted the crate convention that permits future variants without a breaking API change.
attempts.patch: Marked both enums non-exhaustive, reran focused and full verification, and required successful exact-head review before merge.

outcome.summary: Callers can deterministically inspect whether every required identified check passed for one exact Attempt, including mixed and missing evidence, without granting the report any side effects or lifecycle authority.

verification.command: nix develop --command cargo test --locked -p vela-kernel --test task_verification_gates

lessons: Gate policy can remain caller-owned and ephemeral while deterministic code evaluates durable evidence.
Latest matching evidence must be scoped to both exact Attempt and exact check; legacy text cannot satisfy identified gates.
Public Rust errors should remain non-exhaustive when future variants are a compatible expectation.
